overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Active Crypto ETF (TKNZ) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on long cryptocurrency basket, short usd currency. TKNZ is an actively managed exchange-traded product that invests in a diversified portfolio of crypto assets TKNZ was launched on Jul 15, 2026 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
